exposure: Invasive procedures (amniocentesis, cordocentesis, chorionic villus sampling)
cohort: Pregnant women living with HIV in the UK and Ireland between 2008 and 2016.
finding: The study found operative deliveries in 8.2% and 27 invasive procedures among women with HIV, with one infant acquiring HIV after operative delivery and no transmissions after invasive procedures.
mod_finding: Operative delivery, particularly forceps use, increased over time among women living with HIV, with one infant acquiring HIV following operative birth.
